data.one_liner: Amplify Flutter API plugin supporting GraphQL and REST operations.
data.what_it_does: The Amplify Flutter API category plugin enables applications to perform GraphQL and REST operations against backend services. It manages network requests and integrates with the broader AWS Amplify ecosystem.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that uses AWS Amplify for backend services.
You need to make REST or GraphQL API calls integrated with AWS authentication and models.
avoid_when: You are not using AWS Amplify and just need a standard HTTP client.
You prefer a lightweight REST client without the AWS dependency footprint.
strengths: Seamless integration with AWS Amplify backend architecture and Gen 2 outputs.
Supports both REST and GraphQL operations out of the box across multiple platforms.
weaknesses: Tied tightly to the AWS Amplify ecosystem.
Requires proper Amplify project configuration and setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the Amplify Flutter library and configuring backend credentials according to AWS documentation.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a powerful, standalone HTTP client for general REST APIs without AWS dependencies.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a simple, official basic HTTP client package for standard REST requests.

alternatives.name: grpc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your backend communicates via gRPC rather than standard REST or GraphQL.
